At 6, Rhine damage Operators other than Ifrit and the Medics gain 15% (25% for Elites) of the highest base ATK among your deployed devices as extra ATK; several devices do not share twice. At 3 you gain the Eco-Sustainer and the Energy Resonator; at 9 you unlock the single-level full-field Laser Drill. Devices have 300 base ATK, +4 per Research stack. The Eco-Sustainer and the Energy Resonator earn 2 Research Points on a win and 1 on a loss; the 1st breakthrough needs 5 points and the 2nd needs 5. Points reset after each breakthrough and overflow is not kept; Research stacks are unaffected and the Laser Drill neither accumulates points nor breaks through.
基础生命随众魂层数提升。3名：本玩家卡兹戴尔干员本体阵亡化为亡魂，继承普攻、所选:
Base HP rises with Soul stacks. 3: this player's Kazdel Operators leave a wraith behind when they die, inheriting their basic attack, chosen native skill and talents, taking no population slot, with HP and ATK rising with stacks. 6: automatically fire a war cannon at the densest enemy cluster for true damage; stacks raise its damage and charge, and the body's first effective death charges it further. The bombardment deals the same damage to this player's living allies as to enemies; other players' allies and wraiths are immune. 9: the bodies of all of this player's Operators of any faction leave wraiths, without gaining the Kazdel tag or its exclusive traits.
Details: the tier is locked at 3/6/9 at battle start; each Soul stack adds 10 HP to a Kazdel body. A wraith has 60% of the body's base HP + 10S and 80% of its ATK + 3S, excluding Souls and temporary bonuses, and does not inherit equipment triggers. Wraiths have no time limit and are cleared on death, on the body's revival, or at battle end; Medic wraiths only heal wraiths, SilverAsh's second skill can also heal wraiths, and other healing does nothing. The cannon covers 21 cells (5×5 minus the corners), deals 800+15S, holds 15 charges, charges 1+0.005S per second, and the body's first effective death charges 3; the interval is at least 3 seconds, with a 2-second warning counted into the interval. Bombardment and the resulting deaths can produce souls but no stacks or charge; other players, reinforcements, summons, devices and wraiths are not eligible to produce souls; a manual retreat produces none. Same-name Stronghold auras take the highest. Wraiths and cannon are cleared at battle end.
战斗开始时按3/6/9名不同雷姆必拓干员锁定档位。常规援军上限6/12/16；开: The tier is locked at 3/6/9 different Rim Billiton Operators at battle start. The standing reinforcement cap is 6/12/16; 2/2/3 arrive at the start, then 1/2/3 every 10/8/6 seconds, with no arrears at the cap. Rendezvous points are removed; ordinary reinforcements enter from your blue gate, search for a legal reachable enemy inside the fire coverage of a living, deployed offensive Operator of the same battlefield (including co-op teammates), close in and attack, re-targeting when the target leaves coverage, dies or becomes unreachable; with no qualifying enemy they patrol in four directions inside the coverage, and with no coverage they step aside from the blue gate and wait. Reinforcements may overlap each other in movement and resting, including vehicles and the boss, and do not affect deployment or terrain rules; vehicles and the boss keep their own routes. Tiers 6/9 accumulate the total survival time of this player's actually living and deployed reinforcements (including vehicles and the boss): every 1 reinforcement-second gives this player's 【Rim Billiton】 Operators +1%/2% ATK and HP, at most 200%/300% per round; pending spawns do not count, death or exit stops contributing, bonuses already gained are kept, and they carry into this round's Unite from the normal main battle and reset next round. Each standing summon first rolls the 2% combined miner independently, then draws from the current tier's pool; at most 1/2/3 Chefs, and same-name auras do not stack. From tier 6, one Temptation of Gourmet every 20 seconds (first at 10 seconds), passing once deals 1500+5S physical damage to each enemy; tier 9 drops up to 5 standing reinforcements from the school bus every 25 seconds, starting with 1 Kindhearted Boss and then topping up to at most 2 every 30 seconds, the boss having 1000+2S ATK, dropping a bomb every second along its round trip that deals 200% ATK as ground physical damage within a 0.45 radius 1 second later, with no extra round multiplier and without the survival ATK/HP bonus only Operators receive. Reinforcements take no population or Alliance headcount, produce no wraiths, do not trigger recursive summons, and are cleared at battle end.
